1479-2841-3318-8338.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3510-4288-5929-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
3510-4288-5929-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1417-2738-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Bridge from Below, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2997-3652-4336-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2997-3652-4336-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1987-2427-5913.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2427-5913.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk.
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2427-5913.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-2557-3899-5434.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

5256-7124-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
5256-7124-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5256-7124-7358.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

4875-5331-7082.description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}. When it enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
When the Treasure enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token which enters as a Pirate due to Conspiracy.
When the Ally enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
Repeat from step 2.
4875-5331-7082.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop in step 2. This must be stopped at some point or the game ends in a draw.

582-1409-6753.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve the Brazen Freebooter trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-671-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-671-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

460-539-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two colors among permanents you control.
460-539-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Bloom Tender.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.
460-539-5168.notes: To get infinite mana, there must be three colors among permanents you control.

104-3197-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-6752.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

186-1497-4949-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W} that can only be spent to activate an ability of a creature.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2577-4740-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-4740-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
2577-4740-5670.notes: Once you have enough life, you can activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal damage.

2557-2793-3743-5089-5636.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2557-2793-3743-5089-5636.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-5708.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

341-586-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1477-1737-2793.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {5} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the Ugin's Nexus token.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat each turn.

2724-3194-5625.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phelia.
2724-3194-5625.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Phelia. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

939-1822-4404-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping Soul Foundry and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

3002-4050-4234-5307.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
3002-4050-4234-5307.description:
Activate Mesmeric Trance by paying {U} and discarding a card.
 The discarded card is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Ranar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Mesmeric Trance ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {U}.
Repeat.

774-1846-4300-4826.description:
Cast High Tide.
Tap two Islands to add {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Meloku twice.
Activate Patron of the Moon, placing two Islands on the battlefield untapped.
Repeat.
